statement.title: Accessibility statement
statement.intro: We aim for every customer to be able to use the service ticket portal, including people with disabilities.
statement.target: The portal is built to meet the Israeli standard IS 5568 (based on WCAG 2.0) at level AA. This statement describes the target and is not an official confirmation of conformance.
statement.feature1: Every function can be used with the keyboard alone.
statement.feature2: Every field has a visible label, and error messages are linked to the field they belong to.
statement.feature3: Ticket status and the urgent marker are shown as text, not by color alone.
statement.feature4: The portal is available in Hebrew and English, with the matching text direction for each.
statement.limitation1: A full formal accessibility audit of the portal has not been done yet, so there may be issues that have not been found.
statement.limitation2: A photo attached to a ticket is described in text only by the ticket number and the category, not by what the photo shows.
statement.contact: For accessibility requests and comments, contact: {{contact}}
statement.contactMissing: The contact details for accessibility requests have not been set yet.
